verdict.rationale: Antigravity 2.0 documents Scheduled Tasks, where you define a cron schedule and agents start and run autonomously in the background. It also supports scheduled messages to agents while you are away, isolated background worktrees, and a headless CLI mode for scripted and CI-triggered agent runs, so the core scheduled and triggered autonomy story is covered by first-party claims. Missing for 10: documented event triggers beyond CI (e.g. webhooks, issue or alert triggers); clarity on whether schedules run without the desktop app open or only while it is running; examples of agents autonomously fixing and shipping changes (e.g. auto-PRs), given artifact review halts for approval; any independent or hands-on corroboration of Scheduled Tasks.
